steps.en: Install the framework into a Python environment
steps.zh: 把框架装进一个 Python 环境

steps.en: Compose an Agent from a model client and a toolkit of tools
steps.zh: 用模型客户端和工具集组装一个 Agent

steps.en: Runs the reasoning-acting loop, pausing each sensitive tool call for confirmation
steps.zh: 跑推理-行动循环，敏感工具调用先停下来等确认

steps.en: Chat with it and test in the terminal
steps.zh: 在终端里直接与它对话、测试

steps.en: Streams every model call and tool event outward as typed events
steps.zh: 把每次模型调用与工具事件类型化成事件流推出去

steps.en: Start the bundled multi-tenant service backend
steps.zh: 启动自带的多租户服务后端

steps.en: Isolates sessions, executes tools in the chosen sandbox, persists agent state
steps.zh: 按会话隔离、在选定沙箱执行工具、持久化状态

value.en: Serving, sandboxing, permission gates, and tracing come with the framework — you only compose the agent and operate what you opted into
value.zh: 服务化、沙箱、权限闸门、追踪随框架到位，你只负责组装和运维自己开启的部分

sources: agentscope README Quickstart / Agent section (2026-09-27): `uv pip install agentscope`; `from agentscope.agent import Agent`; `await launch_console(agent)`
agentscope README 'Run the following commands to start the agent service backend' — `cd agentscope/examples/agent_service` + `python main.py`

agentscope README building-blocks table: Permission & HITL (confirmation, bypass mode), Workspace/Sandbox (local, Docker, Apple Container, Bubblewrap, E2B, OpenSandbox, Daytona, K8s), Event System; EventType enum in src/agentscope/event/_event.py at tag v2.0.8
